text:
elaine: Heads-up — internal audit asked whether we can suppress request/response bodies for routes that handle PII. Need quick guidance for console toggle & default behavior.

tim: We currently do sampling + full redact for flagged routes. What's 'suppress' vs 'redact' here?

elaine: By suppress I mean: no body stored in audit index; metadata (route, status, latency) still recorded. Redact = store with masks like <REDACTED> which still counts towards storage/observability.

rupert: Suppression reduces storage & egress but makes postmortem debugging harder. Can we do reversible hashing for identifiers? e.g., store sha256(user_id+salt) so joins still possible inside the org.

monica: +1 on hashing but ops asked for per-tenant salt rotation — we should expose salt_id in metadata so authorized lookup is possible.

telemetry-bot: Note: changing storage semantics affects our metrics pipeline. Current ETL expects request.body for feature extraction. We'll need a transform flag.

tim: Proposal: add 3-level enum in route config: "store_full", "mask_sensitive", "suppress". Default for user-facing routes = "mask_sensitive". Admin routes = "store_full" behind opt-in. Sensitive routes auto-detect via schema or tag.

elaine: UX: in Console -> Routes -> Logging tab, show current setting with a prominent warning for "suppress" and a canary rollout toggle (10/25/100%).

rupert: For canary we should allow sampling % + preserve-sample=1 option so we keep 1 in N full bodies for debugging while mask others.

monica: Edge case: embeddings endpoints — we must never store raw input by default. Suggest default = suppress with audit-only hashed id.

tim: Implementation snippet for route config:
```
logging: {
  level: "mask_sensitive",
  sampling: {percent: 5, preserve_one_in: 1000},
  identity_hash: {algorithm: "sha256", salt_id: "tenant-rot-2026"}
}
```

elaine: Policy: retention for masked bodies 90d, for suppressed bodies 7d metadata only. Need legal sign-off.

rupert: Also add an operator override CLI for breakglass: `ri audit fetch --route r123 --breakglass --expiry 1h` that logs who invoked it.

monica: :lock: We need to ensure KMS logs for salt access.

ops-bot: Rollout planned: canary 10% now, escalate to 25% in 24h if no alerts.

tim: Action items: (1) RFC for enum + storage semantics (2) Console mock for toggle & canary (3) ETL flag for suppressed routes. I'll draft RFC by EOD.

elaine: Thanks — please ping legal/infosec on the RFC. I'll add them to reviewers.
